About Us
The Software Company 
With a Heart
Our customers are the heart and soul of our business! That's why we go above and beyond to serve and take the customer experience to whole new heights! Join Our Team 
As Seen In
OUR MISSION
Helping Business Owners
Easily Run Their Business
Whether you are a small yoga studio or a multi-location gym, it is our goal to make it easier to start, run, and grow your business! Our dedicated and knowledgeable team will guide you through picking the right package for your needs, importing your data, training you on the best tools and answering any and every question you have. From making sales, scheduling staff, to building a loyal clientele with email marketing, it is our mission to be your all-in-one solution.
We Care About Giving Back
Tour de Cure by American Diabetes Association
WellnessLiving is committed to giving back to the community by supporting charitable organizations and fundraisers such as the American Diabetes Association's Tour de Cure, a cycling event that helps to raise awareness about diabetes.
OUR CULTURE
Building Something Incredible, Together
At WellnessLiving, we bring people together to create something extraordinary. We're a dynamic blend of leaders and action-takers, united by a shared drive to disrupt the business management software space in new and creative ways. That mindset fuels our passion and commitment — to our product, our customers, and each other. We're one team, one family, and we couldn't do it without every single person at the table.
OUR LEADERSHIP
The Story Behind 
 the CEO & COO
CEO Len Fridman and COO Sasha Davids were childhood friends who lost touch. That all changed when Len was on vacation in Jamaica and thought he saw a familiar face – Sasha!
The pair spent the whole week catching up. Sasha discovered Len’s problems with MindBody and when they got back to Toronto, Canada, they agreed to disrupt the software industry and form a partnership – and just like that, WellnessLiving was born!
Their infectious spirit will draw you in, but being treated like family is what will keep you coming back.
Our success is your success!
